justification: `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/PackageManager.java` has low fan-out: it directly works with only `MetaClass`, `MetaPackage`, `List`, `Map`, and the logger/collections helpers, and its API is small (`addMetaClass`, `getMetaClass`, `getMetaPackage`, `buildPackage`, `getRootPackages`). `core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/model/JITDataModel.java` and `IReadOnlyJITDataModel.java` show it is exposed as a single contained field via `getPackageManager()`. Fan-in is broad but not enough for a hub smell on its own: `rg -l "PackageManager"` found 19 distinct source/test files using it across core/ui/tests, including `ParseUtil.java`, `AssemblyProcessor.java`, `BytecodeAnnotationBuilder.java`, `JITWatchUI.java`, `TriView.java`, `ClassSearch.java`, and `TestPackageManager.java`. The class is reused widely, but it does not itself depend on many other classes, so hub-like modularization is not supported.
